supplementalFinding.description: Supplemental debt is descriptor-derived; producer and integrate-contract debt remain open until their typed closure signals pass, while the checker admits only named repaired authority-presentation transitions.

composition_rule.const: current obligations equal the immutable freeze mapping disjoint-unioned with each exact landing delta, then transformed only by exact source reconciliation rebindings; counts are derived summaries

landing_slice_rule.const: the slice landing a post-freeze production render/export root owns its fresh file/root receipt, independent classification, and behavioral proof
